rules: One pass is one PR, under the repo's 40-file gate.
Every pass runs the loop: build, validate, repair, record. A pass is done only when every gate it names is green.
No raw CSS, no raw colour or size literals. Everything resolves to contract token names (ADR-976 D-1).
No hand-written per-block UI. Panels, chips, labels and icons are read from role.json and defineBlock.
Every pass ships dark behind the render_path flag and is reversible by flipping it.
Baselines only shrink. A rise needs --allow-raise and a written reason, and stays flagged.
Zero editor bytes on the public render. The builder runtime never reaches a visitor.
Every pass also runs G-LEDGER and closes its own row in the same PR, as a fragment (pnpm ledger:close). Never edit docs/BUILD-BACKLOG.json or docs/DECISIONS.md directly.
No new planning-named markdown. The spec lives in docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md; status lives only in docs/BUILD-BACKLOG.json.

loop.do: Read the pass's inputs, write only the files in its scope, add or update the probes it lists.
Run every gate the pass names, in order: static, unit, contract, render, visual, budget. Stop at the first red gate.
Classify the failure, fix inside the pass scope, re-run from the failed gate. Up to 3 cycles.
Write the pass receipt: gates run, results, baseline changes, files touched, open items. Tick the backlog row.

classes.symptom: check:blocks, role schema or fields projection fails
classes.fix: Fix the role.json or defineBlock entry, never the gate. Fields must equal content keys.

classes.symptom: check:tokens or theme conformance names a raw value or an unknown token
classes.fix: Replace with a contract name. If no token can express it, file a token request and stop.
If the diff is the intended change, re-baseline with a dated changelog line. Otherwise revert the render change.
Fix in the editor state module, not in components. One document drives every panel.

classes.symptom: a11y ratchet rises, focus lost, missing label
classes.fix: Fix the control. Never recapture a ratchet to clear it.

classes.symptom: Build budget, shell weight or public-render bytes rise
classes.fix: Lazy-load the editor code path or move it behind the editor route.

classes.symptom: Doc-safety round trip loses a field or an unknown block
classes.fix: Stop. Revert the pass. Data loss is never repaired forward.

repair.escalate: After 3 failed cycles, revert the pass branch, record the failing gate and the last diff, and raise it as a blocker on the backlog row. Do not start dependent passes.

gates.name: check:node-document-safety
gates.note: Frozen corpus of real documents round-trips with zero loss

gates.name: check:stored-blocks
gates.note: Stored page data names only known types

gates.name: check:blocks
gates.note: Script is in package.json (check:blocks). Every adopted block resolves a renderer per declared surface, toText present, migrations contiguous

gates.name: check:roles (new)
gates.note: Every role.json validates, including intent, icon, thumb and slot labels

gates.name: pr-compare visual suite
gates.note: Becomes required in the PR that recaptures its baselines

gates.name: check:render-path and render_path flag-off test
gates.note: check:render-path exact-match ratchet, plus a flag-off render test written in the pass

gates.name: Pass probes
gates.note: The pass's own Done-when tests, written in the pass

gates.name: check:surface-binding
gates.note: Every surface an App declares resolves to a component

gates.name: check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions
gates.note: Runs on every pass: the row fragment and its probe must agree with the tree

phases.name: Align
phases.goal: Settle the nine design-system conflicts so every later pass reads one vocabulary.

passes.title: Token map to the 45 contract names
build: Generate one map from Frequency tokens (Commons, Commons night, Stage) to the contract groups: ground, ink, accent, line, status, band, shape, depth, type, rhythm, motion.
Retire --th-* in element-library.md and theme-pack.json; point them at contract names.
probes: Pin test: every contract name resolves on Commons, Commons night and Stage
Computed values equal today's on the 31 design pages

passes.title: Radius, breakpoints and editor tokens
build: Five radius steps (10, 14, 18, 24, 32) plus pill, mapped to --r-control, --r-card, --r-panel, --r-media.
Breakpoints 600, 840, 1200, 1600 as tokens.
--editor-canvas, --editor-thumb, --editor-ring, --editor-select in Commons and night.
probes: No radius literal outside tokens in templates/admin
Thermal renders from night tokens, no invert filter

passes.title: Build icon group in the sprite
build: Add about 14 icons on the 24px grid, 1.75 stroke: undo, redo, eye, eye-off, device desktop/tablet/phone, outline, pin, unpin, fold, history, surface, variant, sample.
probes: Every icon id referenced by role.json resolves in the sprite

passes.title: Copy canon
build: Primary action on Commons: --pa for the one primary, ink for secondary, no violet. Update site-themes.md.
Calendar name: apply the owner's pick everywhere, including the Circle tab.
Scope banned words to Frequency's own copy; exempt owner and theme names.
Record the Vera authority decision (drafts as diffs, or coaching only).
probes: Text pin: the chosen calendar name appears, the other does not
Voice lint passes with owner names exempt

phases.name: Shell
phases.goal: The new frame on today's document model, single writer, dark behind render_path.

passes.title: Frame, top bar and public-bytes ratchet
build: Full-window canvas, top bar (Space and page, surface switcher placeholder, ⌘K trigger, Publish).
One editor state module; components hold no section state.
Add the editor-bytes-on-public-render ratchet at 0.
probes: Flag off renders the current editor
Visitor bundle contains no builder module

passes.title: Rail state machine
build: States per rail: hidden, strip, overlay, pinned. Pinned pushes the canvas; overlay closes on canvas click and Esc.
Width 300 to 420 for the right rail, persisted per person with pin state.
Breakpoint table from BLD-002. Focus mode hides both rails.
probes: Table test of every state at 1600, 1200, 900, 700, 390
Focus returns to the trigger on close

passes.title: Spine and outline
build: Spine reads the node tree: one thumbnail per section, selected state, drag to reorder, + between.
Outline drawer: section names from role intent and the title slot, hidden-on-device dimming.
probes: Reorder by drag and by keyboard produces the same document
Doc-safety corpus round-trips after reorder

passes.title: Selection and parts overlay
build: Hover outlines a data-part; click selects section or part.
Inline text editing on text parts; image part opens the media picker with focal point.
Section toolbar: move, duplicate, hide on this device, delete with undo toast.
probes: Canvas edit updates Tune rail and back
Every action is one undo step

passes.title: Generated Tune rail, two layers
build: Layer 1 renders slots.required then slots.optional, from role.json, with counts from slot limits.
Layer 2 (More): tone, width, spacing, columns, devices, anchor, reveal, density per surface, from defineBlock.fields.
'Always show more' per person.
probes: For every adopted role, rendered fields equal the projection, no more and no fewer
No component file names a block type

passes.title: Command bar
build: ⌘K and Ctrl+K, plus a visible button on touch.
Three groups: Go to (sections, pages), Do (every action in the action registry), Ask Vera.
Each row shows its shortcut; recent commands first.
probes: Every toolbar and rail action is reachable from ⌘K
Focus trapped while open, returned on close

passes.title: Mobile sheets
build: Bottom bar: Outline, Add, Tune, Vera.
Bottom sheet with the same two layers; 44px targets.
probes: Every Layer 1 and Layer 2 control is reachable at 390 wide

passes.title: Shadow render and cutover
build: Render old and new editors on the same documents; log deltas.
Turn on for internal Spaces, then a cohort.
probes: Zero or explained delta on the frozen corpus

phases.name: Roles
phases.goal: Add by intent, layout chips and readiness, read straight from the role registry.

passes.title: Role contract additions and check:roles
build: Add intent, icon, variants[x].thumb and slots[x].label / hint to all role.json files (21 roles once BLD-210 lands; 17 today).
Extend RoleDefinition; add check:roles validating every file.
Replace the regex tables in block-meta.ts with role fields; keep a fallback for legacy types.
probes: block-meta.ts has no type-name regex for role blocks
Every role icon resolves in the sprite

passes.title: Add by intent
build: + opens 'What should this part do?' with the intents, grouped (21 roles in builder v3).
Previews render each role's default variant with the Space's own data where role.data is set, else the flagged sample.
Insert at the chosen index; select it; one undo step.
probes: Only roles legal for the current kind and surface are offered
Preview uses Space data when present

passes.title: Layout chips with needs and pins
build: Chips from variants with thumb; a chip whose needs are unmet shows why and a shortcut to fill the slot.
Picking a chip sets variant and variantSet: true and shows a pin. Unpin restores the theme default via roleVariant().
probes: roleVariant priority holds: owner, then theme, then role default
Every variant renders non-empty with sample content on every theme

passes.title: Readiness
build: Publish ring with a count: sample words, null numbers, missing alt text, missing SEO.
Canvas tags: 'not yours yet' on sample slots, 'needs a number' on null figures.
Click the count to step through each item.
probes: A page with sample: true content cannot publish without an explicit keep
Null number blocks publish

passes.title: Update to new layouts
build: Surface LIVE-1860's per-page action: preview the role version of each legacy block with a diff, apply as one undo step.
probes: Legacy page renders identically before the action and after undo

phases.name: Lenses
phases.goal: One edit across surfaces, themes tried on over real content.

passes.title: Surface switcher
build: Site, Profile, Spotlight, Email in the top bar; selection persists across switches.
Canvas renders at the surface's declared density; sections the surface cannot show are listed with the reason.
probes: Per block and surface, golden markup matches
Hidden-on-surface list equals blocks without that surface

passes.title: Email lens
build: Email preview through compileEmailDoc; live blocks show their resolveAt: 'send' snapshot.
probes: The 7 draft campaigns and 7 templates render byte-identical to before

passes.title: Theme lens
build: Hover a theme: swap the static theme stylesheet and data-theme on the canvas; prefetch on hover.
Unpinned sections show the theme's default variant; commit is one undo step.
probes: Switching makes no document request once cached
Pinned variants never change on switch

passes.title: View as
build: Visitor, member and host previews using the existing viewer gates.
probes: Host-only blocks are absent in the visitor preview

phases.name: Together
phases.goal: Presence, Vera as a collaborator, and history. Starts after E0 lands.

passes.title: Presence
build: Faces in the top bar, cursors and selections from Yjs awareness. Awareness never touches the document.
probes: Two clients converge to the same tree
Undo reverts only the local client's edit

passes.title: Vera collaborator
build: Vera joins as a client. Tools: read_page, plan_page, apply_edits, validate.
Proposals show as ghosted diffs, accepted per section, one transaction each.
Speaks first only at page creation; after that, only from ⌘K or her rail.
probes: Vera output names only tokens and known slot keys
Accept and undo are one step each

passes.title: History scrubber
build: Timeline of versions; drag to preview; restore one section or the whole page. Publish is a pointer swap.
probes: Restore produces a document equal to the chosen version

phases.name: Hardening
phases.goal: Repeat the full matrix and fix anything that drifted across passes.

passes.title: Full matrix
build: Render every role × variant × theme × surface × device (1600, 1200, 900, 390). Fix overflow, zero-height and contrast findings.
probes: Coverage 1.00 on declared roles
No horizontal overflow at 390

passes.title: Owner walk-through
build: Five owners each build a page from a blank Space while we watch. Log every hesitation and failed find.
Promote any Layer 2 control used by 3 of 5 into Layer 1.
probes: Every owner publishes without help
No control is searched for in ⌘K by more than 2 owners
